INHERITED_LAND_TRANSFER.title: Inherited Land Mutation Document Checklist
INHERITED_LAND_TRANSFER.description: Required documents when transferring land registered in the name of a deceased father/mother or ancestor.

documents.name: Deceased Owner's Death Certificate
documents.purpose: Authoritative proof of demise of the recorded title owner.
documents.alternative: Court declaratory decree if death occurred long ago and unregistered.

documents.name: Legal Heir Certificate (Varisu Saandrizh)
documents.purpose: Establishes all legal heirs entitled to succeed the deceased's real estate under applicable succession laws.
documents.alternative: Succession Certificate issued by Civil Court.

documents.name: Registered Sale Deed / Settlement Deed of Deceased
documents.name_ta: தந்தை பெயரில் உள்ள கிரையப் பத்திரம் அல்லது செட்டில்மென்ட் பத்திரம்
documents.purpose: Proves the root of title and how the deceased person acquired the property.
documents.alternative: Certified copy obtained from Sub-Registrar if original is missing.

documents.name: Current Computer Patta / Chitta Extract
documents.purpose: Confirms existing revenue entry and exact Survey Number and Sub-division.
documents.alternative: Old manual Patta book or Village Chitta copy from VAO.

documents.name: Consent Affidavit / Registered Release Deed from Co-Heirs
documents.name_ta: மற்ற வாரிசுகளின் சம்மத கடிதம் அல்லது உரிமை துறப்பு பத்திரம்
documents.purpose: Required if Patta is to be transferred to one specific son/daughter instead of joint ownership.
documents.alternative: Joint application where all heirs are listed as co-pattadars.

documents.name: Encumbrance Certificate (Last 15 to 30 Years)
documents.purpose: Verifies that no mortgages, agreements, or attachments were created prior to demise.
documents.alternative: Online signed EC download from tnreginet.gov.in.

LAND_PURCHASE_VERIFICATION.title: Before-You-Buy Due Diligence Checklist
LAND_PURCHASE_VERIFICATION.description: Essential documentation to inspect before signing any purchase contract or paying an advance.

documents.name: Seller's Registered Title Deed (Sale/Settlement)
documents.purpose: Confirms how and when the seller legally acquired ownership.

documents.name: Parent / Link Documents (30-Year Chain)
documents.purpose: Traces uninterrupted ownership history and root of title.
documents.issuing_authority: Seller / Previous Owners / SRO Certified copies
documents.alternative: Sub-Registrar certified copies of registered link deeds.

documents.name: Latest Computer Patta & Chitta
documents.purpose: Confirms revenue department recognizes seller as current possessor.
documents.alternative: None - Computer patta is strictly required.

documents.name: Field Measurement Book (FMB) Sketch
documents.purpose: Validates boundary lengths, layout, and extent against physical site.

documents.name: Encumbrance Certificate (30+ Years)
documents.purpose: Confirms property is free from mortgages, court attachments, or disputes.

documents.name: Latest Property Tax / Land Revenue (Kisht) Receipt
documents.purpose: Proof of active possession and up-to-date tax discharge.

BOUNDARY_DISPUTE.title: Boundary Demarcation & Survey Checklist
BOUNDARY_DISPUTE.description: Required documents to resolve boundary confusion, area shortage, or neighbor disputes.

documents.name: Registered Title Deed showing Four Boundaries (Chakkubandi)
documents.purpose: States legal boundaries: North, South, East, West.

documents.name: Current Patta Copy
documents.purpose: Shows official revenue extent and sub-division number.

documents.name: Official FMB Sketch with Adjacent Survey Numbers
documents.purpose: Enables government surveyor to physically place stones and identify encroachments.

PATTA_TRANSFER.title: Patta Transfer Checklist
PATTA_TRANSFER.description: Records relevant to a Patta name-change request.

documents.name: Current Patta / Chitta
documents.purpose: Shows the current revenue record and survey identity.

documents.name: Relevant Registered Title Deed
documents.purpose: Shows the recorded title transaction relevant to the request.

documents.name: Encumbrance Certificate (where relevant)
documents.purpose: Provides registered encumbrance information.

DOCUMENT_EXPLANATION.title: Document Review Checklist
DOCUMENT_EXPLANATION.description: Upload the document you want explained and any supporting record needed for comparison.

documents.name: Land Document to Explain
documents.purpose: Primary document supplied by the citizen for AI-assisted explanation.

LAND_RECORD_SEARCH.title: Land Record Search Checklist
LAND_RECORD_SEARCH.description: Information needed to locate and review land records.

documents.name: Current Patta / Chitta Extract
documents.purpose: Helps identify the current revenue record.
